name: goose-language
description: Syntax highlighting, compiler diagnostics, navigation and tasks for Goose, without a language server.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: Syntax highlighting, snippets and the outline work in Restricted Mode. Running the compiler requires a trusted workspace.

virtualWorkspaces.description: Goose uses a compiler and source files on the extension host's filesystem.

keybindings.when: editorLangId == goose && editorTextFocus && isWorkspaceTrusted && config.goose.useRunKeybindings && debugState == inactive
editorLangId == goose && editorTextFocus && isWorkspaceTrusted && config.goose.useRunKeybindings && debugState == inactive

program.description: Entry file. Defaults to goose.entryFile or the active Goose file.

configurationSnippets.label: Goose: Run with JIT
configurationSnippets.description: Run Goose in a task terminal using the compiler's JIT (no debugger).

goose.compilerPath.description: Compiler executable or command on PATH. Empty searches goose and build/{Release,Debug}/goose in the workspace, then PATH. Relative paths use the workspace folder. Supports ${workspaceFolder}.

goose.entryFile.description: Program entry file, relative to the workspace folder. Empty checks/runs the current file. Set this when editing imported modules. Supports ${workspaceFolder}.

goose.stdlibPath.description: Standard-library directory passed as --stdlib. Empty uses the compiler's default lookup (including GOOSE_STDLIB). Supports ${workspaceFolder}.

goose.checkOnSave.description: Check saved Goose files on open and save. Checks wait until open Goose files in the same workspace folder are saved.

goose.useRunKeybindings.description: Run with JIT on Ctrl+Shift+B (Cmd+Shift+B on macOS), F5, and Ctrl+F5 while editing Goose. Disable to use VS Code's usual task/debug keybindings.

goose.checkTimeout.description: Maximum time in milliseconds for a background compiler check.

goose.runArguments.description: Program arguments passed after -- by Run Program. Each item is one argument.

action.description: Compiler operation. Run uses the JIT and is the contributed build task.

file.description: Source file relative to the workspace folder. Defaults to goose.entryFile or the active file. Supports ${workspaceFolder} and ${file}.

output.description: C output file for generateC; defaults to the source basename with .c.
